== Original and remastered English issuer text ==
The original deploys unconditionally and uses either named Objective as an on-table prerequisite for the listed benefits. The remaster requires Ralltiir Operations to deploy, cancels Ounee Ta, and drops the ongoing Objective condition for its remaining actions.
